Hand record: MWRD's CSO Points layer puts its own outfalls 151 and 152 (IL0028061) and Chicago's 206 and CDS-20 in its 'Cal R' reach, and O'Brien Lock and Dam, one of MWRD's three structures that let the waterways back into Lake Michigan (its reversals table), stands on this river. The USGS NHD high-resolution flowlines carry the Calumet River as GNIS 405379 (6 flowlines, about 12.4 km, reach codes 07120003003394, 07120003012108, 04040001048321 and 04040001000637) from its junction with the Little Calumet River at Hegewisch (41.6434 N, 87.5614 W) through the lock (41.6547 N, 87.5694 W) to its mouth at Calumet Harbor (41.7329 N, 87.5292 W); NHDPlus V2.1 has none of it and gives the id to the Little Calumet River instead (the Little Calumet River's hand record).

waters.name: Little Calumet River
waters.note: NHDPlus V2.1: 6 network flowlines with GNIS id 405379 in IL's box, cut to the state, merged and simplified to ~10 m; only the part within -87.7, 41.6, -87.5614, 41.7 (west, south, east, north) is kept: east of 87.5614 W, the junction with the Calumet River at Hegewisch, the NHDPlus chain of GNIS 405379 runs up the Grand Calumet River to the Indiana line (the USGS NHD high-resolution Grand Calumet River, GNIS 409251, whose flowlines end at 41.6462 N 87.5614 W), which is the record grand-calumet-river-il; review 2026-11-06 P2-1 (reach codes 07120003000061). Hand record: MWRD's CSO Points layer puts Chicago's (IL0045012), Riverdale's (ILM580007) and Dolton's (ILM580017) outfalls and its own Calumet plant's (IL0028061) along this stretch in its 'Little Cal R (North)' reach, and EPA's CSO inventory gives them the receiving water 'Little Calumet River'. This is the river from its junction with the Calumet River at Hegewisch west to Blue Island, as NHDPlus V2.1 draws it; the USGS NHD high-resolution flowlines leave it unnamed. East of the junction NHDPlus's chain is the Grand Calumet River (within_why); MWRD's 'Little Cal R (South)' is the river's south arm, the East Arm Little Calumet River's record. NHDPlus V2.1's GNIS id is not this water's own: NHDPlus names these flowlines 'Calumet River' (GNIS 405379, reach codes 07120003000061 and 07120003000188, in the Little Calumet-Galien basin), while the USGS NHD high-resolution flowlines give GNIS 405379 to the Calumet River from Hegewisch to Lake Michigan (the Calumet River's hand record) and leave this stretch unnamed.
